017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.freemarker;
018
019import java.io.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.*;
022import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
024import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.processor.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.view.*;
026
027import freemarker.template.*;
028
029/**
030 * {@link ResponseProcessor} that detects {@link FreemarkerView}-typed return values and asks the
031 * configured {@link Configuration} to render them directly onto the response writer.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * Auto-registered by {@link FreemarkerMixin} via
035 * {@link Rest#responseProcessors() @Rest(responseProcessors=...)}
036 * &mdash; callers who add the mixin don't need to wire up this class explicitly. Callers who want
037 * to handle {@code FreemarkerView} returns <i>without</i> adopting the mixin can add this class
038 * to their own
039 * {@link Rest#responseProcessors() responseProcessors} list.
040 *
041 * <h5 class='section'>Behavior:</h5>
042 *
043 * <ol class='spaced-list'>
044 *    <li>Inspect the response content. If the value is not a {@link FreemarkerView}, return
045 *       {@link ResponseProcessor#NEXT NEXT} so the rest of the chain runs.
046 *    <li>Read the active {@link FreemarkerMixin} from the {@code RestContext} bean store
047 *       to discover the {@link Configuration} (lazy default if no configuration bean is
048 *       registered) and the optional template-suffix knob.
049 *    <li>Apply every entry from {@link FreemarkerView#getResponseHeaders()} via
050 *       {@link jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse#setHeader(String, String)
051 *       res.setHeader(...)}.
052 *    <li>Default {@code Content-Type} to {@code text/html;charset=UTF-8} if the caller did not set
053 *       one explicitly. FreeMarker's bridge-default {@code Configuration} uses
054 *       {@code HTMLOutputFormat} so HTML is the natural target; an explicit caller header wins.
055 *    <li>Call {@code configuration.getTemplate(templateName).process(view.getAttributes(),
056 *       res.getWriter())} to stream the rendered output.
057 *    <li>When no FreeMarker engine is on the classpath, the {@link Configuration}-typed import
058 *       here fails to load at first use and surfaces {@link #NO_ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC} naming the
059 *       missing dependency.
060 * </ol>
061 *
062 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
063 *    <li class='jc'>{@link FreemarkerMixin}
064 *    <li class='jc'>{@link FreemarkerView}
065 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/ResponseProcessors">Response Processors</a>
066 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/FreemarkerViewSupport">FreeMarker View Support</a>
067 * </ul>
068 *
069 * @since 10.0.0
070 */
071@SuppressWarnings({
072   "resource" // Closeables here are framework-managed and not owned/closed by this class; not a real leak.
073})
074public class FreemarkerViewRenderer implements ViewRenderer {
075
076   /** Default {@code Content-Type} applied when the view does not specify one explicitly. */
077   public static final String DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE = "text/html;charset=UTF-8";
078
079   /**
080    * Diagnostic message emitted when no FreeMarker engine can be found on the classpath at
081    * render-time.
082    *
083    * <p>
084    * Public so tests and consumer apps can pattern-match against the message text without
085    * depending on internal string literals.
086    */
087   public static final String NO_ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC = """
088      No Apache FreeMarker engine is available on the classpath. Add:
089        - org.freemarker:freemarker                       (FreeMarker engine core)
090      Or, for Spring Boot:
091        - org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-freemarker
092          (autoconfigures a freemarker.template.Configuration bean the bridge picks up).
093      Or register a custom @Bean freemarker.template.Configuration with whatever loaders /
094      encodings / output formats you need.
095      See https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/FreemarkerViewSupport for the full matrix.""";
096
097   // Lazily-created fallback used when no FreemarkerMixin bean is registered.  Cached (double-checked) so
098   // the bridge-default Configuration and its template cache are built once instead of rebuilt per render.
099   // Created lazily (not eagerly) so a missing FreeMarker engine still surfaces at render time as
100   // NO_ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC rather than during RestContext construction.
101   @SuppressWarnings({
102      "java:S3077" // volatile is required here for correct double-checked-locking safe-publication of the lazily-built fallback FreemarkerMixin in fallbackMixin(); the reference is publish-once (fully constructed before assignment, immutable thereafter) and never compound-mutated.
103   })
104   private volatile FreemarkerMixin fallbackMixin;
105
106   @Override /* Overridden from ResponseProcessor */
107   public int process(RestOpSession opSession) throws IOException, BasicHttpException {
108      var req = opSession.getRequest();
109      var res = opSession.getResponse();
110
111      var content = res.getContent(Object.class);
112      if (! (content instanceof FreemarkerView content2))
113         return NEXT;
114
115      // Resolve the bridge resource (carries Configuration + cached default + templateSuffix).
116      // Fall back to a cached FreemarkerMixin when the renderer is used standalone
117      // without the mixin.
118      var bridge = req.getContext().getBeanStore()
119         .getBean(FreemarkerMixin.class)
120         .orElseGet(this::fallbackMixin);
121
122      // Apply caller-supplied response headers first so a caller-provided Content-Type wins
123      // over the bridge's default below.
124      content2.getResponseHeaders().forEach(res::setHeader);
125      if (! res.containsHeader("Content-Type"))
126         res.setHeader("Content-Type", DEFAULT_CONTENT_TYPE);
127
128      // Apply the same traversal gate the raw /freemarker/* mount uses so a typed-View template name
129      // assembled from user input (e.g. FreemarkerView.of(userInput)) cannot escape the configured base
130      // path via '../' segments.  Mirrors the JSP bridge's typed-View gate.
131      String safeName;
132      try {
133         safeName = gateTemplateName(bridge.getBasePath(), content2.getTemplateName());
134      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
135         throw new InternalServerError(ex, "FreeMarker template name escapes configured base path: '%s'", content2.getTemplateName());
136      }
137
138      var templateName = bridge.applyTemplateSuffix(safeName);
139      try {
140         var cfg = bridge.resolveConfiguration(req);
141         var template = cfg.getTemplate(templateName);
142         template.process(content2.getAttributes(), res.getWriter());
143         res.getWriter().flush();
144         return FINISHED;
145      } catch (LinkageError ex) {
146         throw new InternalServerError(ex, NO_ENGINE_DIAGNOSTIC);
147      } catch (IOException ex) {
148         throw ex;
149      } catch (TemplateException | RuntimeException ex) {
150         throw new InternalServerError(ex, "FreeMarker render failed for '%s'", templateName);
151      }
152   }
153
154   // Rejects '../'-style traversal in a typed-View template name using the same virtual-path gate the raw
155   // mount applies, returning the configuration-relative template name.  Delegates to the shared
156   // FileUtils.resolveVirtualPathSafely + FreemarkerDispatcher.stripBasePath used by the raw render path.
157   static String gateTemplateName(String basePath, String templateName) {
158      var resolved = FileUtils.resolveVirtualPathSafely(basePath, templateName);
159      return FreemarkerDispatcher.stripBasePath(basePath, resolved);
160   }
161
162   // Returns the cached fallback mixin, creating it once (double-checked) on first standalone render.
163   private FreemarkerMixin fallbackMixin() {
164      var local = fallbackMixin;
165      if (local == null) {
166         synchronized (this) {
167            local = fallbackMixin;
168            if (local == null) {
169               local = new FreemarkerMixin();
170               fallbackMixin = local;
171            }
172         }
173      }
174      return local;
175   }
176}
